figs.name: induction-motor-slip-calculation-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to calculate induction motor slip from nameplate frequency, poles and rotor speed
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the steps to calculate slip for a 4 pole 50 Hz motor running at 1470 rpm and how the slip value sets the operating mode.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to calculate induction motor slip and find the operating mode</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#9a3412" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How to Calculate Slip: Step by Step</text>
<rect x="40" y="62" width="380" height="74" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="93.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Read the nameplate</text>
<text x="230.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">f = 50 Hz, P = 4 poles</text>
<line x1="230" y1="138" x2="230" y2="158" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="160" width="380" height="74" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="191.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Synchronous speed</text>
<text x="230.0" y="215.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Ns = 120 × 50 ÷ 4 = 1500 rpm</text>
<line x1="230" y1="236" x2="230" y2="256" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="258" width="380" height="74" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="289.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Measure rotor speed</text>
<text x="230.0" y="313.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Tachometer: Nr = 1470 rpm</text>
<line x1="230" y1="334" x2="230" y2="354" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="356" width="380" height="74" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230.0" y="387.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Apply the slip formula</text>
<text x="230.0" y="411.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">(1500 − 1470) ÷ 1500 × 100 = 2%</text>
<line x1="230" y1="438" x2="230" y2="470" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="230,475.0 370.0,515 230,555.0 90.0,515" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="230" y="521.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Where is S?</text>
<polyline points="370,515 470,515" fill="none" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polyline points="470,515 470,117" fill="none" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="470" y1="117" x2="495" y2="117" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="497" y="80" width="270" height="74" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="632.0" y="111.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S between 0 and 1</text>
<text x="632.0" y="135.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Motoring (normal)</text>
<line x1="470" y1="237" x2="495" y2="237" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="497" y="200" width="270" height="74" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="632.0" y="231.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S = 1</text>
<text x="632.0" y="255.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Standstill at start</text>
<line x1="470" y1="357" x2="495" y2="357" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="497" y="320" width="270" height="74" rx="10" fill="#eff6ff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="632.0" y="351.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S negative</text>
<text x="632.0" y="375.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Induction generator</text>
<line x1="470" y1="477" x2="495" y2="477" stroke="#9a3412" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="497" y="440" width="270" height="74" rx="10" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="632.0" y="471.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">S greater than 1</text>
<text x="632.0" y="495.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Plugging or braking</text>
</svg>
